remarks: Delightful GEM OF A HOUSE! i Lovingly cared for by the current owners, this home features a NEWLY RENOVATED KITCHEN with quartz countertops, that opens to the vaulted ceiling Family Room, with sliders that accesses the multi-tiered deck and INGROUND POOL in the private backyard. Perfectly great as it is, or you may want to take advantage of the various EXPANSION OPPORTUNITIES this sweet home has to offer. Walk to stores, moments to all Westport amenities from this convenient location.
